title: 「Shortly after ...」表示「……後不久」

omissions: Every numbered Important Rule and Benefit is retained as a separate Chinese-primary card. Where the PDF has no English counterpart, the English explanation is a faithful editorial translation.

formula: Shortly after + noun phrase / clause / V-ing, + main clause

formulas.formula: Shortly after + noun phrase / clause / V-ing, + main clause
Main clause + shortly after + noun phrase / clause / V-ing

example: Shortly after the announcement, the company’s stock price fell.
exampleZh: 公告發出後不久，公司的股價便下跌了。

examples.en: Shortly after the announcement, the company’s stock price fell.
examples.zh: 公告發出後不久，公司的股價便下跌了。
examples.highlight: Shortly after the announcement, the company’s stock price fell.

meaning.zh: 本課練習目標句型：Shortly after + noun phrase / clause / V-ing, + main clause。

rules.zh: （會議後不久，我們便收到最終決定。）
rules.en: shortly after + noun phrase Shortly after the meeting, we received the final decision.
examples: Shortly after the meeting, we received the final decision.

rules.zh: （會議結束後不久，我們便收到最終決定。）
rules.en: shortly after + complete clause Shortly after the meeting ended, we received the final decision.
examples: Shortly after the meeting ended, we received the final decision.

rules.zh: （艾瑪抵達酒店後不久，便致電給家人。）
rules.en: shortly after + -ing phrase Use this form when the person doing the -ing action is clear and is normally the same as the subject of the main clause. Shortly after arriving at the hotel, Emma called her family.
examples: Use this form when the person doing the -ing action is clear and is normally the same as the
Shortly after arriving at the hotel, Emma called her family.

rules.zh: after 後面的事情先發生；主句的事情在短時間後發生。
rules.en: Pay attention to the order of events The event after after happens first. The event in the main clause happens a short time later.
examples: Pay attention to the order of events
The event after after happens first. The event in the main clause happens a short time later.

rules.zh: shortly 表示「不久之後」，不一定是「立即」。
rules.en: shortly does not always mean immediately It means “a short time later”. The exact length depends on the situation.
examples: shortly does not always mean immediately
It means “a short time later”. The exact length depends on the situation.

rules.zh: shortly after 後面必須接名詞、-ing 片語或子句；shortly afterwards 後面不再接其他內容。
rules.en: shortly after ≠ shortly afterwards Shortly after must be followed by a noun, an -ing phrase or a clause. Shortly afterwards stands alone.
examples: Shortly after must be followed by a noun, an -ing phrase or a clause. Shortly afterwards

rules.zh: （雨停後不久，孩子們便走到外面。）
rules.en: Use a comma after an opening Shortly after phrase Shortly after the rain stopped, the children went outside.
examples: Use a comma after an opening Shortly after phrase
Shortly after the rain stopped, the children went outside.

benefits.zh: 這個句型能清楚交代哪件事先發生，以及哪件事隨後不久發生。
benefits.en: It makes the order of events clear This structure tells the reader which event happened first and which event followed soon afterwards.

benefits.zh: 它不只表示兩件事有先後次序，還能指出兩者相隔的時間不長。
benefits.en: It shows that the time gap was short Instead of merely saying that one event happened after another, it tells the reader that the second event followed quite soon.

benefits.zh: 你可以把兩個短句連成一句，使表達更連貫。
benefits.en: It combines two short sentences smoothly Instead of writing two separate sentences, you can connect the events in one complete sentence. Compare: The announcement was made. A short time later, the company’s stock price fell. Shortly after the announcement, the company’s stock price fell.

benefits.zh: 這個句型適合用於故事、新聞、報告和進度更新，幫助你清楚交代事件發生的時間線。
benefits.en: It is useful for stories, news, reports and updates The structure helps you present events in a clear timeline.

benefits.zh: 以 Shortly after ... 開始句子，可以先突出時間關係，亦能減少句首重複。
benefits.en: It gives you another way to begin a sentence Beginning with Shortly after ... places attention on the timing and makes your sentence openings less repetitive.
